supported_oci_subset.layers: one to four gzip-compressed tar layers
supported_oci_subset.entries: root-owned regular files and directories; normal and opaque whiteouts

limitations: Materialization and activation are proved by mounting the prepared origin and real writable thin snapshots; no guest runtime integration is claimed.
All interruption tests are process exits, not VM or physical-host failures.
The worker is currently a serialized CLI; daemon APIs, workload systemd units and distributed publication belong to Release 4.
Capacity guards reserve room for worker-controlled materialization; arbitrary external writes to active snapshots are outside this test.
retained_failures: LVM returned an error when asked to repeat an already-satisfied permission; worker now inspects permissions first.
A thin snapshot existed but was inactive; readiness now requires successful activation and a device node.
The concurrency driver retried a loser before the winning process finished; it now joins both before retrying.
The first complete evidence run asserted but omitted database phase observations; the final fresh run records them.
